messages:

Subject: Planned maintenance: request for patch window and rollback assurance

Neha,

Thanks for taking this. We have an upcoming compliance-driven micropatch on our Private deployment (control plane + inference nodes) and need Redwood's formal plan for: version pinning semantics during the window, a deterministic rollback sequence, and the approval flow for our Security Ops team. Key constraints:
- Zero data plane traffic loss for tokens-in-flight (we need graceful KV cache preservation if possible)
- A 30-minute maximum RTO if we must bail out to a previous model/quantization profile
- Audit trail (who triggered rollback, why, and exact timing) for our SOC review

Can you send the proposed maintenance choreography and confirm a weekend window? We are considering Sat 2027-04-17 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Thanks,
Tim
Platform Lead, Orion Bank

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: request for patch window and rollback assurance

Hi Tim — appreciate the clear constraints. High-level answers up front:
1) Version pinning: during the window we recommend "soft pin" on the active model version for 1 hour prior to the patch to capture a stable traffic slice, then a hard pin for the duration of the maintenance. The hard pin will prevent automated rollouts or model variant switches.
2) Rollback sequence: we propose a brokered rollback ("rollback-broker") that is a short, auditable choreography: preflight snapshot -> drain non-critical requests -> switch routing to pinned fallback variant -> validate smoke metrics -> lift drain. Expected RTO is targetable to 20–30 minutes with the checks in place.
3) Approval flow: Security Ops authorizes via DocuSign link (included below) and we require a 2-person approval (Security lead + Customer ops) to trigger the hard pin.

I've attached a draft maintenance choreography (redwood-maintenance-draft-v1.pdf) and a staging preflight checklist (staging-preflight-checklist.csv). Can your team confirm the weekend window you proposed? If confirmed, we'll run a dry-run on Wed 2027-04-14 in a staging replica.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood-maintenance-draft-v1.pdf, staging-preflight-checklist.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: design for rollback-broker + ops handoff (for Orion Bank)

Team — looping you in to design the operational bits for Orion's window (they tentatively accepted Sat 2027-04-17 02:00-05:00 UTC). Key asks from Tim are inlined above. Proposal below (high-level then actionable checklist):

High-level approach (novelty: rollback-broker):
- Preflight snapshot: create config + KV cache snapshot at T-60m, store in S3 (immutable).
- Soft pin: set routing weight to pinned model variant 90/10 for T-60 to T-15 to collect tail behavior.
- Hard pin: at T-15 set hard pin on orchestration API (disables any autoscaling-driven model swaps).
- Drain strategy: for the control-plane-deploy, we will apply a graceful drain on non-priority queues; live token-in-flight preservation handled via KV streaming into the snapshot and short-lived affinity cookies so in-flight tokens are routed to the same runtime where possible.
- Brokered rollback: if any smoke gate fails (latency > 20% or error rate > 1.5x baseline), the rollback-broker executes: 1) mark incident in Jira (RI-3421), 2) set routing rule to pinned fallback variant, 3) initiate KV rehydration from snapshot if required, 4) run validation suite, 5) hand control to customer ops for final sign-off.

Action items (owners & timing):
- soojin_lee: implement hard pin API gating and test idempotency; deliver by 2027-04-13 EOD.
- karthik_iyer: build and test KV snapshot/restore procedure in staging; include timing benchmarks; deliver by 2027-04-13 EOD.
- marissa_cole: draft comms and approval template for Security Ops (DocuSign link + audit fields); deliver by 2027-04-12 COB.
- neha_kapoor: coordinate dry-run Thursday 2027-04-14 and runbook owner during window; create final rollback-matrix-v2.xlsx.

Risk notes & mitigations:
- Risk: cache rehydration may cause spike in tokenization latency. Mitigation: run canary with 5% traffic and measure tail p95/p99 before wider rollout.
- Risk: operator error when toggling routing rules. Mitigation: gating flag with 2-person confirm and automated rollback triggers if smoke gates fail.

Docs & links: staging checklist, draft maintenance choreography attached. I'll create the Jira ticket and hubspot link for tracking.

On Wed's dry-run we'll exercise the broker on a staging replica with a synthetic load profile. Please reply with confirmations or objections inline — want this locked by Tue EOD so Tim can route to their Security Ops.

— Neha

Attachments: rollback-matrix-v2.xlsx, staging-preflight-checklist.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: design for rollback-broker + ops handoff (for Orion Bank)

Neha — looks good. Quick confirmations:
- I'll scope the hard pin API as a single POST to /orchestrations/{deployment}/pin with body {version, expires_at, approvers:[list]}. It will emit an immutable audit event with operator id and timestamp.
- KV snapshot: Karthik and I agree to use chunked transfer to S3 with MD5 checksums; rehydration will happen into a separate read-only cache instance to avoid write interference.
- Dry-run: I'll provision the staging load generator and produce a p95/p99 baseline report to compare against.

One ask: add an explicit step to notify the backup ops team to freeze automatic backups for the maintenance window to avoid double-throttling the network. I can add that to the checklist.

Sooj
